scope_boundaries.allowed_claim: Independent visual review of the exact 52 original card PNGs from the pinned actual capture, plus selective original-PNG/WebP alpha compositing at unchanged native resolution. No other visual view or release gate is approved by this report.

scope_boundaries.required_next_gate: Freeze exact final card metadata and evidence, capture the final exact detail/wheel subject pairs, and independently inspect those originals before any full website/release claim. Mandatory CI, platform approvals and explicit user authorization remain separate.

independence.reviewer_role: new independent visual reviewer; not asset maker or capture producer
independence.manual_observation_basis: Each original image was loaded by view_image detail=original and individually inspected. Statistics only corroborate integrity, framing and a specific alpha question.

source_context.original_static_qa_summaries_consulted: Existing summaries in original_static_record.qa_findings were read solely to understand the intended subject and scope after direct pixel inspection; no static verdict was substituted for visual review.
source_context.charnia_history: The historical concept brief pin 81300b... is preserved as history. Active fa9c75... context is not treated as a mismatch invalidating the pinned card GLB. This report does not rewrite or re-certify that source history.

nonblocking_observations.finding: Readable at inspected native capture size, with especially subdued central relief in spriggina. No broader fine-detail readability claim at every card size.
